subject: CAIQ artifact provenance playbook & sampling rotations — draft for owners
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CAIQ artifact provenance playbook & sampling rotations — draft for owners

Hi team,

Sharing a first-pass playbook for how we capture and attest to artifact provenance for CAIQ/CSA control mappings. This is intended to sit alongside the control crosswalk (we already have that) and act as the operational rulebook for sampling rotations, custody stamps, and minimal evidence required per control grouping.

Attachments: caiq_provenance_playbook_v1.pdf (playbook prototype), sampling_matrix_Q1-Q4.xlsx (rotation proposal), artifact_steward_roster.csv (current owner roster).

Key asks:
- Review ownership assignments on the roster and confirm by EOD Wed (kimberly, marcus).
- Decision on sampling cadence: proposed quarterly rotation across live/edge/archive strata (see matrix). If we need monthly for high-risk controls (P-AC, DS-5 equivalents), flag it.
- Confirm minimal provenance stubs: 1) artifact manifest (hash + path), 2) ingestion timestamp + owner, 3) environment tag (prod/staging/dev), 4) an event-level telemetry log excerpt when applicable.

Notes on scope: this playbook focuses on artifacts we use to respond to CAIQ claims where the control asks for "evidence of operationalization" (logs, runbooks, manifests). We intentionally exclude long-tail third-party deliverables (those stay in vendor risk).

Timeline suggestion: sign-off by next Friday 2026-12-24; populate Drive folder; handoff to audit team week of 2027-01-04.

I tried to keep the playbook prescriptive and lightweight — sample rotation sits in the spreadsheet with a proposed steward cadence.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: caiq_provenance_playbook_v1.pdf (19 pages, draft), sampling_matrix_Q1-Q4.xlsx, artifact_steward_roster.csv

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T10:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ artifact provenance playbook & sampling rotations — draft for owners

Tessa — thanks for drafting this, nice and practical. A few quick suggestions inline: 

- Sampling cadence: I agree with quarterly for low/medium risk. For any control that maps to telemetry-backed assertions (e.g., controls that require evidence of request-level isolation or KV cache eviction), we should sample monthly for the first two quarters after rollout and then move to quarterly.
- Telemetry excerpt: I'll drop a small log snippet (kv-cache-telemetry-snippet.log) into the Drive folder. That should illustrate the minimal slice we expect (timestamp, trace_id, operation, owner_id).
- Retention clarification: we should add a short clause for ephemeral dev artifacts (14 days) vs prod artifacts (12 months). Also propose an administrator exception workflow (email + Jira) for artifacts that exceed the retention window for ongoing investigations.

On owners: Kimberly, Marcus — if you can confirm the steward list row for your teams I can map the sampling rotations to owners and create the JIRA ticket that drives uploads.

On attachments: I'm including the telemetry snippet as an example; not a production extract.

Cheers,
Priyom
Sr. Controls Engineer | Redwood Inference

Tessa / Kimberly —

Thanks for sharing the playbook. A few clarifying requests from the audit side before we accept the sampling plan for Galactic Health's CAIQ review: 

1) For controls that assert "evidence of isolation or runtime segregation", we need a chain-of-custody stamp showing the artifact creation -> transfer -> ingest timeline. Can you confirm whether the artifact manifest schema includes a signed timestamp and owner identity (the playbook mentions manifest + owner but we need the stamp example)? If not, can you provide an exemplar (redacted) manifest?

2) Please provide one deployment-runner.log covering a recent deployment that shows the artifact hash, the deployment job id, and the environment tag. This can be redacted to hide PII but must preserve the artifact hash and job id for traceability.

3) For telemetry-derived assertions: can you confirm the sampling algorithm (random, stratified by env, or time-window)? Auditor preference is stratified sampling by environment and by high-risk control buckets.

If you can provide the exemplar manifest and a redacted deployment-runner.log by COB 2026-12-22, that will keep us on the requested timeline.

Best,
VeriDoc Audit Team

I'll also upload a short how-to: "How to generate an exemplar manifest and redaction checklist" into the Drive link and add it to the JIRA ticket. Once the artifacts are in place we'll notify VeriDoc and Galactic Health procurement.
